title: Hongik Harness: Modular Architecture & Repo-Aagnostic Verification
desc: Design patterns for decoupling AI agent harnesses from document repositories, enabling shippable and verifiable engine independence.
steps: 1. DECOUPLING: parameterized all hardcoded paths with dynamic variables like testRepoRoot or env:WKHARNESS_REPO_ROOT.
2. MODULARIZATION: broke monolithic guards.ps1 into 9 targeted modules (guards-shell, guards-write, guards-agent, etc.) dot-sourced by a lightweight hub.
3. VERIFICATION: implemented repo-agnostic selftests using a sandbox to ensure 100% engine pass regardless of host repo.
4. SECURITY: integrated model-spoof protection and bypass evasion detection as core guards.
author: claude
